_readme: County planning contacts shown under the 'What the county allows here' table, keyed by 'County|ST' matching a property's county and state. Every number was confirmed on the county's own official page on 2026-11-18, not from search snippets. Luna County lists no planning-specific number on its public pages, so it uses the county main line. A number that looked like Luna Planning in search results (575-543-6621) turned out to be a code enforcement district contact, so it is deliberately not used. Re-verify before adding a county, and update here if a number changes.

Klamath|OR.source: klamathcounty.org staff directory, Planning Division: 541-883-5121 Option 4
